objective.name: sandbox.dsl.branch.remote
objective.description: Branching DSL flow driven by a previous sub-response and terminating on either a local or remote wrapper-backed capacity.

#root.role: Read local state, branch on the returned context id, and choose a local or remote wrapper-backed terminal call.

effects.local_engine_route: A local engine-native state read is awaited.
effects.branch_terminal_route: The chosen terminal route invokes either a local or a remote wrapper-backed capacity.

transformation_contract.morphing: A local DSL request becomes one branch-specific wrapper terminal response selected from a previous local engine-native sub-response.
invariants: The branch condition is evaluated only after a successful local read.state result is available.
Exactly one terminal wrapper route is selected between the remote and local branches.
Branching is driven only by local_state.payload.context.context_id.
success: On success, the terminal payload comes from either the remote or local sandbox.echo route selected by the branch.
When the context id matches /root/alpha_child, the successful branch is the remote wrapper route.
failure: The flow fails if the local read.state precondition step cannot complete.
The flow also fails if the selected terminal branch route cannot execute.
notes: This scenario is the simplest proof that DSL branch decisions can switch between local and remote wrapper terminals.
Only the selected branch is executed.
